decision: 5 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 5 for the 12 month period).
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, and in-car video evidence. Russell was overtaking on the outside of Tsunoda on the front straight and into turn one. Russell was ahead of Tsunoda at the braking point, but Tsunoda appeared to brake a little later. Tsunoda was on the dirty inside line and having braked later he then understeered into Russell. The Stewards determined that Tsunoda was predominantly at fault for the collision.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
